scope: Interpretation clarifications recorded before Wave2 endpoint generation; no altered experimental settings or metrics
sample_unit: Report all paired noises and parent means; 3 repeatedly inspected DEV parents do not constitute an untouched generalization test
wave1_numeric_threshold: DEV POST FF_illegal_affected_free_fraction <= 0.16, exactly; do not round 0.160752 to a pass
wave1_visual_condition: Retain actual YES/NO/UNCERTAIN labels and all deterioration cases. Visual noninferiority is not automatically established by an improved mean FF
clean_success_observations: TRAIN and DEV POST FF and bulk-bulk illegal pair counts lower than PLAIN_S1000
Check additional deleted faces, retained surface/face counts, visible cracks and fragments
Report parent/noise concentration and both RAW and POST/BOUND costs
clean_causal_limit: Supports or fails to support this static source-quality weighting intervention; does not prove source defects uniquely cause generation defects. Whole-batch weighted denominator increases the absolute coefficient of unweighted owner/clean coordinates, so owner weight1 is not an unchanged absolute seam gradient
surgical_success_observations: DEV POST connected components, boundary edges and FF below equal-budget PLAIN_S1000
Check normal-forward seam-third MSE and CF/I, retained surface and connection costs
Require actual frozen-state identity and inherited AdamW moments, with preprocessing gradients retained
surgical_causal_limit: Freezing weights does not freeze hidden representations: trainable coordinate/time/role/Geo embeddings still change inputs to frozen blocks. A gain supports this parameter mask, not a uniquely demonstrated shallow attention drift mechanism
significance: No posthoc p-value threshold or noise-as-independent-parent significance claim; report paired effect sizes and consistency

metric_scope.I: ConflictCov_C query-weighted coverage on C, not whole-mesh surface conflict rate
metric_scope.bulk_reach_ge_30: Descriptive legal-common-edge graph reachability threshold; not a watertightness or complete-interface certificate
metric_scope.FF: Fraction of retained free faces touched by illegal FF pairs, plus absolute pair counts and denominators
metric_scope.visual_review: Nonblind AI_PROXY finite views, not human evaluation or exact topology certification

stop: Complete authorized fixed endpoints and evaluation, independent audit, then stop; no alpha scan, extra update, combined recipe or default promotion
